office: the Division of Immigration of the FSM Department of Justice, Palikir, which alone issues the passport

routes.label: from the Division of Immigration, Palikir

note: The fee for a new or renewed passport in the instructions for the FSM passport application (revised July 2007) that the national government's Office of Personnel publishes: $50.00 by money order or cashier's check to the FSM National Treasury; a replacement for a lost, stolen or damaged passport is $75.00 (not modelled). Citizens in the United States apply by post to the same office and add $13.00 for postage (not modelled). Validity is the ten years of section 205 of title 50 of the FSM Code, whose words the 2005 bill C.B. No. 14-11 keeps while letting regulations set a shorter period for minors and senior citizens; no such regulation was read, and the enacted code (fsmlaw.org) refused the request (406). The processing time is a lead.
